name: GTV Engineering Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1990, GTV Engineering Ltd is 
in the business of high-tech steel fabrication.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GTVEL is a Heavy & Large Fabrication & Large Machining company working as a subcontractor for various engineering companies. It is engaged in the execution of several Infrastructural Projects & shop-manufacturing activities. It can further take up the site erection & commissioning activities.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 69.8% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.74% over past five years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -8.00%
